baslik: 🎙️ FREE TEAMSPEAK HAS STARTED IN SEXYKO! | Your Clan's Own Voice Server · Set Up in 3 Steps

metin.Clanına özel, düşük pingli ses sunucusu: Your clan's own low-ping voice server — set it up in 3 steps
metin.SexyKO olarak oyuncularımızın clan içi i: At SexyKO we've activated the Free TeamSpeak system to make our players' in-clan communication faster, more stable and easier.
metin.**Artık ekstra ücret ödemeden, düşük pin: **Now you can create your own low-ping TeamSpeak space without paying anything extra and start using it with your clan.**
metin.1. ADIM — PANELDEN TEAMSPEAK BÖLÜMÜNE Gİ: STEP 1 — OPEN THE TEAMSPEAK SECTION IN THE PANEL
metin.Açılan ekranda sizden istenen bilgileri: Fill in the information requested on the screen that opens.
metin.Gerekli bilgileri eksiksiz şekilde doldu: Fill in all the required information completely.
metin.Bilgileri tamamladıktan sonra TeamSpeak: After completing the information, you can create your TeamSpeak server.
metin.🔑 **İşlem tamamlandığında sistem tarafın: 🔑 **When the process is complete, the system will create a KEY just for you.** Be sure to save this KEY.
metin.3. ADIM — KEY İLE İLK GİRİŞİNİZİ TAMAMLA: STEP 3 — COMPLETE YOUR FIRST LOGIN WITH THE KEY
metin.✅ **İşlem tamamlandı!** Artık clanınızla: ✅ **Done!** You can now start using your low-ping TeamSpeak service with your clan completely free.
